in_marathi.name: Nivritti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, attraction, pull
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivritti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nivritti refers to the deep-rooted desire or attraction towards something. It is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'nivr' meaning to draw back, to attract. This name is often used to describe the irresistible pull towards the divine or the inner self.
